content: Multi-tenant right-to-erasure is harder because data spans many locations/backups. Recommended approach: soft-delete plus periodic purge job for data where immediate hard delete is operationally complex; tenant-scoped export/erasure jobs filtered strictly by tenant_id. GDPR permits deleted data to persist in immutable backups until the backup's own retention/rotation expires, provided it's not actively used and is purged on schedule (i.e., you don't need to surgically scrub backups, just document the retention and let them age out) - obligations continue after subscription ends, so purge/anonymize must run regardless of billing status.
